decision: Tail events query plans an index scan over eval_event.at and filters, so its cost grows with every event in the table older than the batch

decision: Materialize the per-trial match (uses the trial,seq unique index) before ordering by at
why: Stops the planner walking the at index across other batches

decision: Select only trial id and payload for journals, and trial id, seq, payload for tail
why: drizzle mapped and Date-parsed every event row's at and id

decision: Report: query only the reported run's plan, and skip the four resets when open inserted a fresh trial

decision: Run independent reads concurrently (batch row with runs, costs with journals, case list with filters, variant counts with trials)
